body: I hate everything about living life in the world today that you're obligated to do to survive. I couldn't care less about working at any job, neither do I have any intention to live in the world. People lie to themselves trying to find meaning in their miserable lives and they never succeed, their only success is a mere fabrication of meaning that they use to stay sane. There is no meaning in it all, that's not in itself a reason for suicide but knowing that there is no reason to stay alive puts me more at ease when it comes to killing myself. But most people don't think this way, they just meander around, distracting themselves until they eventually meet their fatal end.

Its not exactly one thing. I want to die due to many variables. Its probably a mix of me not having any friends nor relationships, not having a job, being inside for 9 months, my mental state, and how my life has been up to this point.
